name: pwsh
description: PowerShell discipline for agents: objects not text, non-interactive cmdlets, and gating destructive commands (files, services, AD, Hyper-V, registry).

translate.summary: bash to PowerShell translation table: files, text, env, processes, chaining, redirection, exit codes, native commands

pipeline.summary: Objects in the pipeline: Select/Where/ForEach/Sort/Group/Measure, Format-* last, $_, calculated properties, ConvertTo-Json, errors (-ErrorAction, $?, $LASTEXITCODE, try/catch)

files.summary: Files and paths: Get-ChildItem, Join-Path, Test-Path, -LiteralPath vs -Path, Get/Set-Content encoding, Copy/Move/Remove-Item, providers (Env:, HKLM:, Cert:)

text.summary: Text and data: Select-String, -match/-replace/-split, regex, here-strings, ConvertFrom-Json, Import/Export-Csv, Invoke-RestMethod

process.summary: Processes, services, jobs, remoting, scheduled tasks, event logs, timeouts (Start-Process -Wait -PassThru, Start-Job, Wait-Job -Timeout, Invoke-Command)

noninteractive.summary: Everything that prompts in PowerShell and its non-interactive form: -Confirm:$false, -Force, Read-Host, Get-Credential, Install-Module, winget, UAC, execution policy

scripts.summary: Writing scripts and modules: param/CmdletBinding, ShouldProcess (-WhatIf), Set-StrictMode, $ErrorActionPreference, try/catch/finally, Write-Verbose, Pester, PSScriptAnalyzer

windows-admin.summary: Windows Server admin safely: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, GPO, Hyper-V, registry, firewall, features; -WhatIf first, identify by DN, back up before change, do not cut your own access
